technology_name: A METAL HYDRIDE-BASED REACTOR SYSTEM WITH OPTIMIZED GAS DISTRIBUTION FOR ENHANCED HYDROGEN PURIFICATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Hydrogen Storage Engineering / Thermal Reactor Hardware
problem_solved: Standard metal hydride storage beds encounter extreme localized thermal blockages during fast hydrogen absorption cycles, which limits gas purification throughput metrics.
description: An advanced hydrogen purification reactor system containing a robust metal hydride containment frame, an internal optimized gas distribution central duct array, and high-density heat exchange fins to maintain uniform temperature bounds.
applications: Green hydrogen purification stations, industrial fuel cell supply arrays, renewable energy storage infrastructure, and specialized metallurgy gas feeds.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
